name: ExaWizards Inc.
summary: ExaWizards Inc. develops AI-enabled services for industrial innovation and social problems solutions in Japan. It operates through AI products and AI solution segments. The company provides AI solution services; and services for AI understanding, planning, design, development, operation, and usage. It also develops and offers AI products to solve generic industrial and social issues. ExaWizards Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
